articles.title: The enclave and its limits
articles.summary: Recent Pentagon data reveals over 750 US soldiers have sustained injuries in attacks linked to Iran since the conflict began. This significant statistic underscores the ongoing human cost and persistent security challenges faced by US forces in the region. Such developments highlight the volatile nature of international relations and geopolitical tensions, crucial for understanding global defence dynamics and strategic implications.

articles.title: Turkish naval platforms take center stage at Teknofest in Gölcük
articles.summary: Turkish Navy vessels sailed the Izmit Gulf on August 19, preceding Teknofest's maritime-focused 'Blue Homeland' event. Hosted from August 20-23 at Gölcük Naval Shipyard, this highlights Turkey's commitment to naval capabilities, indigenous defence technology, and strategic maritime doctrines. This initiative emphasizes the critical importance of a robust navy for national security.
